_approach: The log drum left alone: no kick, tomLow+congaLow keep a slow, syncopated figure with a thin shaker underneath - the genre's habit of letting the log drum 'imply a pulse without continuously stating it'. NOTE: tomLow+congaLow approximate the log drum's RHYTHM only - the real log drum is a tuned, pitch-bent kick/808/bass hybrid this drum-only library cannot reproduce; the melodic/bass part must come from a synth.
